say:6:1410637201:0.text: These dragon eggs are dull, almost identical to regular echorites. There's no trace of the Divine Dew in them.
say:6:1410637201:0.source_cn: 这里的龙蛋颜色灰暗，与普通的深岩晶一样，我感受不到里面...

say:7:1410637202:1.text: That's because the essence has been drained. These empty dragon eggs are void of any life.
say:7:1410637202:1.source_cn: 因为里面的蛋清都被抽干了，龙蛋已经失去了生命力。

say:8:1410637203:0.text: To the Essail, they're just empty shells, but we dwarves still find some worth in them.
say:8:1410637203:0.source_cn: 对于艾塞勒来说，这些空蛋壳毫无作用，只有我们还在乎它的...

say:9:1410637204:0.text: *Sigh* This place is truly pitiful, like a graveyard for unborn lives...
say:9:1410637204:0.source_cn: 唉……这地方真惨啊，就像未出生的孩子的乱葬岗。

say:10:1410637205:0.text: Back then, I thought the forbidden grounds guarded by General Thador were something to revere...
say:10:1410637205:0.source_cn: 在知道事实之前，我一直以为都铎将军把守的禁地十分神圣，...

say:11:1410637206:0.text: This is a breeding ground for evil!
say:11:1410637206:0.source_cn: 只是一个罪恶盛开的地方！

narration:15:14010642:0.text: You all find a pile of dull dragon eggs. They're cold and lifeless.
narration:15:14010642:0.source_cn: 你们看到了堆叠着的黯淡的龙蛋，它们已经没有了生息。
